name: Bell's Christmas Trees
tagline: About The Farm – Bell's Christmas Trees
description: Bell's Christmas Trees is an agritourism farm in 622 Mettacahonts Rd, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
